causalSequence: char halved onion, sliced ginger in dry pan or over flame until blackened in spots; scrape off burnt skin
dry-toast star anise, cinnamon, cloves until fragrant
simmer store beef stock with charred aromatics, toasted spices, fish sauce, sugar ~18-30 min, partially covered; skim
partially freeze steak 15-30 min; slice paper-thin across grain
cook rice noodles per packet; rinse cold, drain
divide noodles between bowls; lay raw beef slices on top
bring broth to rolling boil; ladle over so it cooks the beef
top with bean sprouts, coriander, spring onion, raw onion, lime; hoisin/sriracha at table
techniqueFacts: all 4 sources char onion + ginger; smoky char is the signature broth flavour
3 sources dry-toast the whole spices before they go in
quick form (2 sources): store stock + aromatics simmered 18-30 min; one cuts beef stock with chicken stock 4:1 for a clearer, sweeter broth; one adds 200 g chuck chunks for body

long-simmer form (2 sources): parboil bones 2-3 min and rinse for a clear broth, then simmer bones + chuck/brisket ~3 h uncovered, skimming; pull the meat when chopstick-tender (~45-105 min), chill, slice thin
raw paper-thin steak is cooked by the boiling broth in the bowl (all 4); freeze 15-30 min first to slice thin (3 sources)
season broth slightly over-salty; noodles and garnishes dilute it (2 sources)
minimum spice set for pho aroma: star anise + cloves + cinnamon (1 source states; matches both quick recipes)
1 source blanches beef slices 30 s in the broth for cooks who dislike visible raw meat
pipeline note, not sourced: rice noodles and fish sauce are GF; hoisin and some stocks/sriracha need a GF-label check
